original_turns_through_checkpoint.text: Good morning. Maya Rivera is here for urgent follow-up after the weekend high-potassium visit.
Yes, this is the kidney follow-up after the Saturday urgent-care call about potassium.
I will verify the bridge plan, medications, and callback preferences before Dr. Hsu joins.
Please do not leave detailed voicemail right now; my contact setup is temporary this week.
Noted: no detailed voicemail while the temporary callback plan is active.
Weekend bridge note: potassium was 5.9 on Saturday, improved to 5.5 after treatment, no EKG emergency changes.
Bridge medication changes were stop lisinopril, stop spironolactone, continue amlodipine 5 mg daily, and take Lokelma today and tomorrow.
I wrote that down as stop lisinopril, stop spironolactone, continue amlodipine, and take Lokelma today and tomorrow.
I am entering the bridge medication list exactly as reviewed.
I brought her in. I only need the lab and visit times so I can manage rides.
Ride and scheduling support only is fine. I am not sharing lab values or clinical details with you.
Yes, Daniel can hear appointment times and ride logistics only for now.
First plan is repeat BMP on Mon Mar 9 at 8:00 AM and nephrology follow-up on Tue Mar 10 at 2:00 PM.
The Tuesday visit works. The Monday lab is early but I can make it.
Calendar recap: Mon Mar 9 8:00 AM repeat BMP and Tue Mar 10 2:00 PM nephrology follow-up.
Same-day return precautions are chest pain, palpitations, or severe muscle weakness.
I have the red flags as chest pain, palpitations, or severe muscle weakness.
Pharmacy recap: stop lisinopril, stop spironolactone, continue amlodipine 5 mg daily, and Lokelma today and tomorrow.
That matches the bridge plan.
There is also a Mila Rivera checking in later today, so I am double-marking the date of birth to avoid chart mix-ups.
I am Mila Rivera for orthopedics, not the nephrology follow-up.
Thanks, Mila. I will keep the charts separate.
The weekend repeat panel is filed as potassium 5.5 with creatinine back at baseline.
Good, so the bridge plan stays the same until Monday labs.
Please remind me of the exact medication changes one more time.
Medication recap: stop lisinopril, stop spironolactone, continue amlodipine 5 mg daily, and take Lokelma today and tomorrow.
Thank you. That is clear.
Do you still want Daniel copied on ride-only timing updates?
Only the appointment times, not the labs or the reason for the visit.
Understood: scheduling only for Daniel.
I also need a temporary callback plan because Maya is not staying at her usual apartment for two nights.
Use the Harbor House desk number for now. Please keep it quiet and do not leave details there.
Temporary callback line is 628-555-0192 extension 44 and the desk should ask for alias Nia.
Temporary contact recap: call 628-555-0192 extension 44, ask for alias Nia, and leave no detailed voicemail.
Yes, that is the temporary callback plan until I move back.
I am only using that line for callback logistics, not detailed messages.
Just tell me whether Monday lab is still 8:00 and Tuesday nephrology is still 2:00 so I can drive.
Yes: Mon Mar 9 8:00 AM repeat BMP and Tue Mar 10 2:00 PM nephrology follow-up.
Please repeat the red-flag symptoms back to me before you leave.
Chest pain, palpitations, or severe muscle weakness mean I should return the same day.
